entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just calling to see how to do that.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with your order number? And just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, no, the band is fine. It’s beautiful. My order number is VF88602. It's... it's a preference, I guess. It's just... I can't use it.
I see. Could you tell me a little more about why you can't use it? Sometimes there are features we can walk through that might help it fit your needs better.

It's not the features. I had a medical emergency right after I got it. I was in the hospital for weeks and had to have surgery. I bought it to get healthy, and now... now the doctor says I can't do any serious activity for months. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really need this money back for my medical bills.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful. I hope your recovery is going smoothly. Let me pull up your order information and check the policy for you. One moment.
Thank you. With my husband's deployment coming up too, every little bit helps. It's just been a really hard time.

I can only imagine. Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've got your order here. It looks like it was delivered 37 days ago. Let me just check the policy... yes, okay. Good news. You are still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's... that's wonderful. I was so worried I'd missed the deadline with everything that happened.

Not at all. I am more than happy to process this return for a full refund for you. I'm sending the prepaid return label to the email on your account right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Thank you, Diana. Truly. This is a huge weight off my shoulders. I really appreciate your help.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, and I wish you the best.
You as well. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a speedy recovery.
